title: Reviewed is not authenticated — The Platner Record
description: OG card for the standards note: REVIEWED (an editorial judgment) vs AUTHENTICATED (a standard of proof), with the amber unchecked box motif. “Sort of” is not “confirmed.”
alt_text: Dark card. Mono kicker: The Platner Record, a note on standards. Large serif headline: Reviewed is not authenticated. Two columns contrast REVIEWED — an editorial judgment (a reporter looked, and judged it credible enough to publish) with AUTHENTICATED — a standard of proof (shown, under a defined test, to be what it is claimed to be), beside an amber unchecked box. Italic line: “Sort of” is not “confirmed.” The standard applies to everyone. Footer: makes no finding of fact; reads the words as given.
creator: Daniel Ismael Aguilar
usage_note: Social card for the Reviewed Is Not Authenticated note. Vector master (.svg) provided alongside the PNG.
